doc:
What this proves

The cartridge performs real ROM-to-high-WRAM packet staging, decodes one SVX2 keyframe followed by in-place delta frames, validates every 4,480-byte output CRC, and only then releases force blank. An NMI-counted scheduler uploads each completed frame to Mode 7 VRAM on its exact presentation VBlank.

30 fps full-pipeline result

The emulator regression charges packet DMA, assembly decode, and the 4,480-byte presentation DMA. It records 482 presentations in 1,200 VBlanks after boot validation, with zero CRC failures, zero deadline slips, and many complete reel loops. A 60 fps attempt missed 160 deadlines in the same window, so this cartridge deliberately ships at the proven 30 fps cadence.

Source footage: NASA Artemis I press-site camera, November 16, 2022. Hit Verify fidelity to require the cartridge's two-loop target gate live in this tab.
